label: Events Landing Page
description: Landing page for events such as World Forums, conferences and live experiences.

components.label: Secondary Navigation
components.description: Navigation bar anchored below the global header, providing in-page or section-level navigation links.
components.note: Agent generates nav item labels only. URLs and structure are set by the publisher.

fields.label: Nav Item Label
fields.hint: Short, scannable label. No punctuation. Examples: Overview, Agenda, Speakers, Register.

fields.label: Nav Item URL
fields.hint: Set by publisher. Agent does not generate URLs.

components.label: Hero Marquee
components.description: Full-width hero component placed at the top of the page. Sets the visual and editorial tone of the page. Contains a heading block with title and primary CTA, plus a visual asset (image or video).
components.note: Agent generates all text fields. Image and video assets are provided by the publisher.

fields.label: Hero Title
fields.hint: Impact statement that communicates the core value or theme of the event. No full stop. Active voice. Example: Where the world's technology leaders converge.

fields.label: Primary CTA Label
fields.hint: Action-oriented label. No filler words. Examples: Register Now, Save Your Spot, Learn More.

fields.label: Primary CTA URL
fields.hint: Set by publisher. Agent does not generate URLs.

components.label: Section Heading Block
components.description: Standalone heading block used to introduce a page section. Typically contains a title and optional supporting text.
components.note: Fields to be completed after Storybook review.

fields.label: Section Title
fields.hint: Clear and direct section title. No punctuation at the end.

components.label: Universal Group
components.description: Flexible container organism used to group and lay out cards or other components in a structured grid.
components.note: Structural container — agent does not generate content for this component directly. Content is generated for the components nested inside it (e.g. arc-card).

components.label: Card
components.description: Content card used to highlight a speaker, topic, session or key information item. Typically used in groups inside arc-universal-group.
components.note: Fields to be completed after Storybook review. Agent generates title and description per card instance.

fields.label: Card Title
fields.hint: Concise title for the card item. No punctuation at the end.

fields.label: Card Description
fields.hint: One to two sentences providing context or detail. Plain language.

components.label: Content Block
components.description: Rich text block used for body copy, supporting text or descriptive paragraphs within a section.
components.note: Fields to be completed after Storybook review.

fields.label: Body Copy
fields.hint: Informative paragraph aligned with the section context. Conversational but professional tone. No bullet points unless explicitly needed.

universal.label: Page Intent
universal.hint: What is the primary goal of this page? e.g. Drive registrations, Inform attendees, Recap event results.

universal.label: Target Persona
universal.hint: Select from the predefined persona list.

universal.label: Locale / Language
universal.hint: Target language and region for content generation.

templateSpecific.label: Event Name
templateSpecific.hint: Full official name of the event. e.g. ServiceNow World Forum Amsterdam 2026.

templateSpecific.label: Event Date
templateSpecific.hint: Date or date range of the event. e.g. June 10–11, 2026.

templateSpecific.label: Event Location
templateSpecific.hint: City and venue. e.g. Amsterdam, RAI Convention Centre.

templateSpecific.label: Event Theme or Key Message
templateSpecific.hint: The central theme or positioning of the event. e.g. Accelerating AI-driven transformation.

templateSpecific.label: Target Audience
templateSpecific.hint: Who is this event for? e.g. CIOs, IT leaders, HR executives.

templateSpecific.label: Key Topics or Tracks
templateSpecific.hint: Main subjects or session tracks. e.g. AI, ITSM, Employee Experience, Security.

templateSpecific.label: Registration URL
templateSpecific.hint: URL for the registration CTA. Provided by publisher if available.
